title: Integral models for bounded constructible continuous E complexes
statement: For prime ℓ and finite normed E/ℚ_ℓ, use the integral coefficient ring, constructible categories and actual derived scalar extension of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. On every scheme X with Noetherian underlying topological space, every bounded constructible continuous E complex K is isomorphic in the full E derived category to integralScalarExtension(M), for some bounded constructible integral complex M. No global lisseness of M is asserted.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.13 and Proposition 6.8.14(2), constructible integral lattices and rationalization

proof.text: Use constructible integral lattices on refined locally closed strata, extend by zero, and clear denominators in the finitely many extension classes in bounded truncation triangles. The rationalization equivalence identifies the resulting complex with K. The compact-test localization calculation and inverse image from the point identify its rationalization with the actual derived integralScalarExtension.

lean.statement:
theorem continuousConstructible_integral_model (X : Scheme.{u})
    [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X]
    (K : ProEtale.BoundedConstructible
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X)) :
    ∃ M : integralConstructible ℓ E X,
      Nonempty ((integralScalarExtension ℓ E X).obj M.obj ≅ K.obj)
